<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" type="device"> <diagram id="d3-inductive-bias" name="D3 inductive-bias probe"> <mxGraphModel dx="1200" dy="700" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1169" pageHeight="827" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0"/> <mxCell id="1" parent="0"/>
<mxCell id="title" value="<b><font style="font-size: 18px">Diagnostic 3: Inductive-bias probe</font></b><br><font color="#666666">Does the pretrained model carry the world model? Give it a new job with almost no data and see what it brings.</font>" style="text;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="200" y="20" width="780" height="50" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="lblMain" value="<b><font color="#888888">MAIN PATH</font></b>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="140" width="100" height="20" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lblBase" value="<b><font color="#888888">BASELINE</font></b>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="390" width="100" height="20" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- 1 Pretrained --> <mxCell id="b1" value="<b>1 Pretrained model</b><br>trained on next-move prediction<br>never told the rules" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e8f0fe;strokeColor=#1a56c4;strokeWidth=2;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="90" width="170" height="90" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <!-- 2 New task --> <mxCell id="b2" value="<b>2 New task</b><br>"where is the walker now?"<br>only 16 labelled examples" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff4e0;strokeColor=#c47a00;strokeWidth=2;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="270" y="235" width="170" height="90" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <!-- 3 Adapt --> <mxCell id="b3" value="<b>3 Adapt</b><br>fine-tune whole model, gently<br>add a new output head" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e8f0fe;strokeColor=#1a56c4;strokeWidth=2;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="500" y="90" width="170" height="90" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <!-- 4 Test set --> <mxCell id="b4" value="<b>4 Fresh test set</b><br>300 unseen sequences<br>same rules, hit the walls" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff4e0;strokeColor=#c47a00;strokeWidth=2;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="730" y="235" width="170" height="90" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <!-- 5 Acc A --> <mxCell id="b5" value="<b>5 Accuracy A</b><br>0.64" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e8f0fe;strokeColor=#1a56c4;strokeWidth=2;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="960" y="100" width="120" height="70" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <!-- 6 Untrained --> <mxCell id="b6" value="<b>6 Untrained model</b><br>same architecture<br>random weights" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f3f3f3;strokeColor=#777777;strokeWidth=2;dashed=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="380" width="170" height="90" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <!-- 7 Adapt baseline --> <mxCell id="b7" value="<b>7 Adapt</b><br>same 16 examples<br>same number of steps" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f3f3f3;strokeColor=#777777;strokeWidth=2;dashed=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="500" y="380" width="170" height="90" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <!-- 8 Acc B --> <mxCell id="b8" value="<b>8 Accuracy B</b><br>0.39" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f3f3f3;strokeColor=#777777;strokeWidth=2;dashed=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="960" y="390" width="120" height="70" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <!-- 9 Gap --> <mxCell id="b9" value="<b>9 Gap</b><br>A minus B<br>+0.25" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e6f7ea;strokeColor=#1e7d3a;strokeWidth=2;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="1090" y="225" width="90" height="110" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- Verdict note --> <mxCell id="note" value="<b>Reading the gap.</b> Big and positive: pretraining carried the world model into the new task. Near zero: it carried nothing useful.<br>Extra check: if the adapted model matches the no-walls shortcut (0.53) on wall cases, it learned counting, not the world." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f7f7f7;strokeColor=#bbbbbb;align=center;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="270" y="495" width="630" height="50" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>

svg.text: Does the pretrained model carry the world model? Give it a new job with almost no data and see what it brings.
Reading the gap. Big and positive: pretraining carried the world model into the new task. Near zero: it carried nothing useful.
Extra check: if the adapted model matches the no-walls shortcut (0.53) on wall cases, it learned counting, not the world.
